primary_workload: daily_report.py: load transaction records from parquet, filter active accounts, merge with reference table, compare transaction timestamps to deadline DatetimeArray column, compute time-window violations, render summary stats

acceptable_targets.description: Any modification to the DatetimeArray comparison path in datetimelike.py that achieves >= 1.5x speedup on the end-to-end workload with primary performance gain attributable to the comparison operation
acceptable_targets.acceptance_criterion: correctness_pass AND end_to_end_speedup >= threshold AND main_perf_gain_from_comparison_path

misdiagnosis_counterfactual.note: Eliminating parquet I/O entirely yields at most 1.064x speedup (below the 1.5x threshold). Actual bottleneck is DatetimeLikeArrayMixin._cmp_method (~71% of runtime). Verified by GH#37462 comment: i8 comparison is ~2x faster than M8/m8.
